failure.message: capacity_stop: system swap grew during arm

stop_accounting.explanation: The worker records a generation in checks before running capacity_check. Twelve output records reached progress events; the thirteenth output, natural-2048-qa, exists only in the final checks because the following capacity check stopped the run.

capacity_evidence.interpretation: The declared no-system-swap-growth gate was violated even though this process remained below its RSS ceiling. System-wide swap does not attribute the increase to this process or to packing; arm C performs no packing. Values are conversions of reported vm.swapusage counters, not direct page-level swap accounting.

internal_data_consistency.limits: These checks validate internal recorded consistency only, not regenerated inference, numerical parity, finite cache state, or candidate equivalence.

source_identity.snapshot_reconstruction: Two identified post-run edits were reversed in memory, but the resulting SHA256 did not match the run manifest; no guessed source snapshot was saved. Current runner contains additional later repairs and is not byte-identical to r1. Parent tool history is additional provenance, not a standalone exact source artifact.
source_identity.reproduction_requirement: Preserve an exact launched-source snapshot for future captures and use a new run identity after source changes. Do not relabel r1 as a result of the repaired runner.

natural-64-extraction.semantic_schema: unmeasured: baseline wording declares no fixed keys

quality_audit.summary_failure_interpretation: Both saved natural summaries contain three bullet items plus an introductory line. The declared validator requires exactly three nonempty bullet lines, so these are formatting failures under the frozen contract; it would be inaccurate to say they contain fewer than three bullet items.
quality_audit.extraction_failure_interpretation: natural-64-extraction returned prose instead of a complete JSON object. natural-512-extraction parses as an object, but schema/factual completeness is unmeasured and cannot be inferred from JSON validity.
unmeasured_semantics: extraction semantic schema and factual completeness
quality_audit.short_fixture_observation: The saved 64-target QA/context/extraction outputs say notes are unavailable. The length-fitting baseline fixture builder does not enforce retention of each task-required fact, so short-fixture adequacy needs a separate CPU token/message audit before attributing these outputs solely to model ability.
quality_audit.cpu_fixture_reconstruction_status: A tokenizer-only reconstruction was attempted and interrupted before producing reconstructed fixtures. No claim of independently confirmed missing prompt facts is made.
quality_audit.known_validator_limitations: Control progress labels whole_model_pass do not establish task-quality success. This run stopped before final quality aggregation, and exact candidate token identity, if later measured, would establish output preservation only.

permitted_conclusions: The control correctness attempt was launched and stopped at its declared capacity gate.
The final file preserves thirteen output records, while twelve records passed the subsequent capacity checks recorded as events.
Saved control outputs expose declared formatting failures and unmeasured semantic quality.
Most model/runtime/spec artifacts match the run manifest; the current worker source differs from the launched worker.
prohibited_conclusions: No packed projection speedup, slowdown, equivalence, memory improvement, or candidate rejection can be inferred.
No screen finalist, full benchmark, confirmation, promotion, or deployment decision was established.
Single correctness-request timing fields are not repeated matched benchmark evidence.
The system-wide swap increase does not prove the control process caused memory pressure or that the model cannot fit.
follow_up: Retain r1 as a stopped attempt and use a fresh unique control run after environmental readiness.
Freeze the exact current runner and all governing source/spec hashes for the next capture.
Keep task-quality failure separate from incomplete execution and token-equivalence evidence; shared control failures block selection under the specification.
Do not loosen the swap, quality, or latency gates in response to these observations.
limitations: No external causal attribution of system swap is available.
The original runner exact source snapshot could not be reconstructed from inspected artifacts.
The new run, if any, is outside this r1 audit.
